land.text: the Nuwakot region and the Kathmandu Valley (Kantipur)

predecessors.note: Thakuri rule began "When the Lichchavi rule ended"; the infobox names the Licchavi kingdom as predecessor.

land.text: the Kathmandu Valley under the Malla dynasty (Cliopatria row from 1202)

successors.note: "After the fall of the Thakuri dynasty, a new dynasty was founded by Arideva or Ari Malla" - the page gives no date. The infobox says "Disestablished: c. 1200 CE"; the text says rulers held power "up to the middle of the 12th century CE".

capitals.name: Kantipur (Kathmandu)
capitals.note: The page says Gunakama Deva (949-994) founded Kantipur, modern Kathmandu, and that the state "mostly ruled the present-day region of Nuwakot" (about 27.9N 85.2E); it does not explicitly call Kantipur the capital.

correction.text: the Nuwakot region and the Kathmandu Valley (Kantipur)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has none; its Kathmandu row begins 1202 at 661 km2). The page says the dynasty "mostly ruled the present-day region of Nuwakot" and, elsewhere, "southern Nepal" up to the mid-12th century; the two statements conflict and the page names no frontier, so the Kathmandu Valley with Nuwakot is drawn as a minimum.

region.text: the Nuwakot region and the Kathmandu Valley (Kantipur)

ledger.note: 879: Raghava Deva founds the Thakuri dynasty. He "is said to have founded a ruling dynasty in 879 CE" and Nepal Sambat "began on 20 October, 879 CE"; "The Thakuri dynasty's existence is disputed by some historians."

1080: Bama Deva ends Shankara Deva's line. Bama Deva "is said to have defeated Shankara Deva in 1080 CE" and "restored the old Solar Dynasty rule in Nepal"; the page is unclear whether this is the same state or a new one, so colour continues.

region.text: the Nuwakot region and the Kathmandu Valley (Kantipur)

ledger.note: c. 1200: the Thakuri state ends. Infobox "Disestablished: c. 1200 CE"; "After the fall of the Thakuri dynasty, a new dynasty was founded by Arideva or Ari Malla" (the Malla dynasty), with no date.

certainty.note: No frontier named on the page; only the Nuwakot / Kathmandu core is placed.

sources.title: Thakuri dynasty
sources.note: Dates c. 879-c. 1200, Raghava Deva, rulers, Nuwakot, Bama Deva 1080, Malla succession.

notes: One page only (the other Nepal pages opened for licchavi-kingdom do not reach 879). The page says the dynasty's existence is disputed, that its end is 'c. 1200' (infobox) or 'the middle of the 12th century' (text), and that it ruled 'Nuwakot' and also 'southern Nepal'. It is silent on Khasa Malla and Karnat expansions: the 'Nanyadeva, King of the Karnats of Mithila' attack on Nuwakot has no year on this page (no entry in wars for that reason); a gap-filler should open 'Karnat dynasty' and 'Khasa Malla kingdom'. No Tibetan or Kashmiri contact is on the page.
